sharedBand.title: Terms
sharedBand.hint: Names only. A circle's size is the total count of the kinds hanging under it (derived)

legend.upper: Line to a broader term (⊂ points the way; ≡ is two-way)
legend.sharedSize: Term circle = total count of its children (derived)

pick.hint: Pick two circles to relate (a kind, a term or a standard term). While selecting, clicking a circle does not leave this page.
pick.unavailable: Circles can't be selected at this level (per dataset). Click a dataset circle to open its surroundings, then select.

relations.subClassOf: ⊂ Start is a kind of the end (kinds)
relations.subPropertyOf: ⊂ Start is a kind of the end (items)

error.same: A term can't be related to itself. Pick a different circle.
error.mixed: A kind and an item can't be related. Pick two kinds, two items (or an item and a quantity kind).
error.cycle: This relation would form a loop (the end is already below the start). Check the direction.
error.invalid: This pair can't be related (it includes a term that hasn't been created, or mixes a kind with an item).
